caption: A patio umbrella is opened in the sun, and a round shadow appears on the ground beneath it.

sa.check: A round shadow appears on the ground beneath it.
The shadow appears as the umbrella opens.
The shadow moves when the umbrella is tilted.

pc.expect: The shadow appears as the umbrella opens and lies on the side away from the sun.
pc.fail: The shadow is there before the umbrella opens; or it lies toward the sun; or it is missing with the umbrella open in sunlight.

pc.expect: The shadow matches the umbrella's round outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or stays small when the umbrella is fully open.

pc.expect: The shadow moves only when the umbrella moves.
pc.fail: It drifts by itself; or it stays put when the umbrella is tilted; or it moves before the umbrella.

pc.expect: The canopy opens as taut fabric on ribs.
pc.fail: It is rigid like a plate; or floats off; or tears.
A second shadow appears; or the umbrella vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the pole passes through the table.

pc.expect: The umbrella's colour and the patio stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The canopy changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the patio changes.
